a.lede: No American company, including NVIDIA, can sell technologies to Megaspeed without a license from the federal government.
a.title: Commerce Department adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist

b.lede: As Jensen Huang returns to his post as Nvidia's CEO with support from the Trump administration, the Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed to its Entity List, which blocks trade with the company, citing national security risks.
